messages:
Mina: Quick follow-up from today's KV shard flapping postmortem. We need owners for remediation -> test additions: regression promptset, focused load test, and a controlled chaos drill to exercise shard eviction fallback.

Josh: Agree. Split immediate (promptset) vs medium (load + chaos). Immediate should cover user flows that forced cache regen.

Carla: I'll own the promptset. Will extract traces and create 6 seeds: cold-start, long-context, burst-many-short, high-token, streaming-edge, non-stream. ETA: end of sprint (Thu).

Sam: I'll own the load harness. Plan: k6 ramp 100->2000 rps over 10m and include an optional stage to flip TTLs via admin API to simulate evictions. Need the trace window for realistic mix. @Josh please attach.

Josh: Trace and ops notes here: https://redwood.internal/trace/EVT-2026-kv-evict. Ticket TICKET-4821 has snapshots.

Mina: Acceptance for promptset: should catch regressions in CI. Define regression = >10% tail latency increase OR >2x token generation cost vs baseline. Store in evals/kv-evict/ and run nightly.

Carla: Will open PR with prompts + expected outputs and a small local harness. Adding streaming vs non-stream variants.

Sam: Example TTL flip command to include in load job:
`curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://ops-api.internal/shards/7/ttl -d '{"ttl_seconds":30}'`
I'll make TTL toggle an optional k6 stage.

ops-bot: Created TICKET-4900 "kv-evict: promptset+load+chaos" assigned Carla, Sam. Due 2026-05-14.

QA-bot: Nightly eval job configured: evals/kv-evict runs 03:00 UTC, posts failures to #eng-platform.

Josh: Recommend a tabletop Tue and live drill Wed next sprint. Who leads tabletop?

Carla: I'll draft scenario doc and checklist (prechecks, rollback, observability asserts).

Sam: I'll prepare harness + safe playbook to induce eviction with kill-switch and traffic cap.

Josh: I'll update alerts (e.g., sustained cache miss rate >5% for 2m -> page SRE) and add dashboards.

Mina: Owners recap: Carla = promptset PR by Thu (TICKET-4901), Sam = load script + TTL by next Tue (TICKET-4902), Josh = monitoring + traces by Mon (TICKET-4903). Tabletop Tue, live drill Wed next sprint. I'll write the post-drill summary and update the postmortem.

Carla: Will ping product/solutions for rollout sign-off once PRs are up.

Mina: Thanks all. Bump here if anything slips; I'll close the loop when TICKET-4900 moves In Progress.
